description.texte: Anthropic's skill for connecting an external API to an MCP server, in TypeScript or Python with FastMCP. Claude runs four phases: API study, implementation, review and testing with MCP Inspector, then evaluations.
passages: This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude.
Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
Creating a high-quality MCP server involves four main phases:
Test with MCP Inspector: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector
After implementing your MCP server, create comprehensive evaluations to test its effectiveness.

interet.texte: Everything is designed for the agent that will call the tools: prefixed, action-oriented names, short descriptions, targeted and paginable results, errors that say what to do next.
passages: Clear, descriptive tool names help agents find the right tools quickly.
Use consistent prefixes (e.g., github_create_issue, github_list_repos) and action-oriented naming.
Agents benefit from concise tool descriptions and the ability to filter/paginate results.
Design tools that return focused, relevant data.
Error messages should guide agents toward solutions with specific suggestions and next steps.

exemple_usage.texte: Once the server is done, the guide has you write 10 realistic questions, with no destructive operation, to see whether an LLM really uses it well.
passages: Question Generation: Create 10 complex, realistic questions
Read-only: Only non-destructive operations required
Use evaluations to test whether LLMs can effectively use your MCP server to answer realistic, complex questions.
